name: Avoid Retribution
body:
Discipline psychoportation; Level cryptic 2, gifted blade 2, psychic warrior 2, tactician 2

MANIFEST

Display mental
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Duration: 1 round/level

Range: personal
Target: you
Power Points 3

DESCRIPTION

This power allows the manifester to bleed his personal space into another’s creatures, so that if he is adjacent to another creature and incurs an attack of opportunity, he can, once per round, redirect it to the other creature. Augment: For every 4 additional power points you spend, you can redirect an additional attack of opportunity.
